news_items.title: REGISTRATION IS NOW CLOSED
news_items.description: Thank you to all who have registered for the Hope Malaysia LGL Conference 2026! Registration is now officially closed. We look forward to seeing all our registered leaders at Hope Kuala Lumpur on August 29–31, 2026 for a powerful weekend of Refresh, Refuel, and Recommit.

news_items.title: REGISTRATION ALERT: 400+ LEADERS REGISTERED!
news_items.target_group: Assistant Life Group Leaders (ALGLs), Life Group Leaders (LGLs), and above.
news_items.description:
Excitement is building for the Hope Malaysia Life Group Leader Conference 2026! We are thrilled to announce that 400+Adults have officially registered to join us on this pivotal weekend. With seats filling up rapidly, we are approaching maximum capacity for our venue at Hope Kuala Lumpur.

This conference will be a cornerstone event designed to Refresh, Refuel, and Recommit our hearts to ministry. Through powerful plenaries and deep fellowship, leaders will be equipped across our four focus pillars: Equiping, Growth, Inspiration, and Fellowship.

news_items.title: INFORMATION PACK HOPE MALAYSIA LGL CONFERENCE 2026
news_items.description: The official Information Pack for the Hope Malaysia LGL Conference 2026 is now available for download. This comprehensive booklet outlines essential details, including the daily program schedule, registration guidelines, payment information, hotel recommendations, and travel logistics. All Assistant Life Group Leaders and above are highly encouraged to download and review this pack before the conference.
